prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create an exquisite fine-art paper collage in exact landscape 1672x941. Aged ivory paper, muted indigo printed photographic textures, restrained amber light, handmade ragged edges, shallow physical paper shadows. A cinematic still life of a single folded ivory letter in the lower-left, a large weathered empty indigo picture frame tilted on an old desk, a faint torn monochrome photograph of a quiet empty street behind. Cool rainy blue light. Spacious ivory right half. Nostalgia without human figures. No words, letters, text, logos, people or watermarks. Bottom 18 percent quiet ivory for editable Chinese lyrics. Gallery quality and rich tactile detail, no digital glossy effects.
